left in src/app/admin/** and src/components/ui/**. It may only ever go
DOWN. Lower it when you remove literals; never raise it.
This started at 717. The Phase B sweep took it to 154 by substituting
every literal whose colour was numerically identical to an existing
It cannot reach 0 — see dynamicAllowance below.
Computed-hue literals like `oklch(88% 0.025 ${hue})`, where the hue is
derived per identity (hueFromId(staff.id)) so each person gets their own
avatar/chip colour. They live in inline style={{}} objects, not Tailwind
classes, and have NO static token equivalent — a token is one fixed
value, and the entire point of these is that the value varies per row.
Plan section 7.8 specifies flipping this guard to zero-tolerance 'on
completion'. That is unreachable while these exist, and section 7 never
mentions them. They are allowed by count and by file here instead, so a
NEW dynamic literal in a NEW file still fails the guard.
